In detail

Marassi — the football stadium and the prison — plus San Fruttuoso and Staglieno with its monumental cemetery. Both Marassi and San Fruttuoso appear in 2026 local reporting on the neighbourhoods with security criticalities. Otherwise a dense, ordinary residential valley floor that visitors see on match days.
